Casting for Indie Pilot
Title: Friends, Sex & Altitude

Genre: Comedy 

Logline: Friends, Sex & Altitude follows a friend group of twenty somethings, Clover, Sabrina, Vivianne, Evan, and Lola as they romanticize their lives in Colorado. Each character grapples with their own challenges; relationships, financial hardships, work, and the delusion you'll have it figured out by 25.

Roles: 

Pam, Woman , any ethnicity, 45 -60, Manitou hippie, says just about anything that comes to her mind. Is a barista at Noah’s Coffee Shop.

Homeless Man, Male, 25-60, Homeless, serves as comedic releief at the end of the episode.

Clover’s Dad, Male, 55-65, Mexican, voiceover role.

Each role consists of one - two lines. 

Production Company: Husser House Productions 

Production Type: Pilot, Live Table Read

Contact Information: taylor@husserhouseproductions.com

Run Time: 27 pages

Compensation: Paid - $200 for one day. 

Union Status: Non- Union

Audition Information: please send headshots, resume and reel to the email above.  Location, Requirements, Callback date: will be casting from tape 

Shooting Schedule: Rehearsals August 23rd and September 6th. Shoot dates October 4th -9th. 

Filming Location: Colorado Springs, CO

Project Description: We are currently crowdfunding to bring the pilot episode to life.

Hey guys - just doing a shout out for an open mic cabaret night in Dalston next Wednesday 29th July  @ Ridley Road Market Bar. 

We are welcoming more performers to join us and perform an act - it could be a song, spoken word, comedy or an extract of something you are working on? Are you going to Edinburgh this year? 

This is unpaid as we are fundraising towards taking our show to Edinburgh but there is no pressure to donate! We want it be a gathering of creatives and a chance for us all to share our work - an opportunity to network and a platform for you to perform.  

We also have a specific casting call:

We are looking for an actor of Jamaican/Carribean heritage who feels comfortable with the Patwa (Patois) dialect to be able to read a couple of Benjamin Zephaniah's poems at our event. 

We are really excited to be welcoming Qian Zephaniah to our event, who has endorsed our show 'Dear Cathy'. One of his poems is part of our show and central themes that he speaks of. You would also be welcome to perform anything else that you would like of course! 

This would be a really special part of the evening and we hope you can join us! 

Please comment below and/or DM me if you are interested and would like to know more.

Thanks so much, DC team. xX

items.text:
We are now casting  for our touring   Autumn show Viva Las Vegas .

The show is a musical  show featuring songs  of Sinatra, Judy Garland , Fred Astaire And Ginger Rogers  as well; as songs from Top Hat,  Easter Parade, The Wizard Of Oz  and more.

We are looking for an experienced hardworking M/F  performer who are keen to take quality musical shows to the community  based   venues .

The show is a one man/woman show so we are looking for experienced performers that can hold an audience and are looking for engaging vocalist performers.

Rehearsals- 24th -28th August  

Playing Dates- 31st  August  -30th October touring  Midlands and Northwest 

We work Monday to Friday (2 x 60 minute shows per day)

Casting Breakdown

We are offering 700 to 750 per week plus fuel on the road as well as accommodation allowance  if needed on the road

Please send details including a singing reel to info@theentertainmentproviders.co.uk

Norwegian Cruise Line Coast-to-Coast Dancer Audition Tour!

**NCL is holding open call auditions in San Diego, Albuquerque, Dallas, St. Louis, Detroit, Hershey, and Williamsburg for dancers. Please visit the link below for locations and dates.**

[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/auditions.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/auditions.html)

Please be prepared to learn multiple dance combinations and bring a hard copy of your current headshot and resume. Female identifying dancers, please bring dance heels and dance flats. Male identifying dancers, please bring sneakers/trainers and a flat jazz shoe.

Seeking dancers for mainstage productions onboard the Norwegian Getaway including Bring Back the 90s, which blends exuberant dance, powerhouse vocals, and stunning multimedia design to deliver an immersive ‘90s theatrical experience like no other. From the iconic fashion and irreverent pop culture to the music, fads, and unforgettable moments that defined a generation, this show takes the audience on a whirlwind journey through everything that made the ‘90s unforgettable.

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

Rehearsals begin November 9, 2026
Board the Norwegian Getaway on or about December 9, 2026
End of contract TBD 6-8 months onboard
Itinerary: Caribbean
***All dates subject to change.***

DANCERS: $800/week onboard, $560/week rehearsals

In addition to mainstage performances, cast members will also participate in and/or cover for other various entertainment offerings such as parties and pop-up events. All cast members are provided with a single occupancy cabin onboard, including Dancers. Cast will be Crew Members onboard with no cruise staff duties outside of the performance schedule.

***Dancers who audition will also be considered for all upcoming opportunities on Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises in addition to the Norwegian Getaway.*

**Must be 18 years or older to apply.**

**SEEKING DANCERS**

Female-Identifying Dancers 5’2 – 5'9
Male-Identifying Dancers 5’8 - 6’3
ALL ETHNICITIES

Strong, athletic dancers who showcase technique and finesse while moving from style to style. Major training emphasis in commercial jazz, ballet, contemporary, and hip-hop styles. Tap a plus! The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. The ability to engage with an audience and tell a story is a must. Tumbling/acro a plus. Singing is not required.

**CASTING CALL – AGENT REID**

***Project Shadow***** (Student Film Trailer)**

**Manchester Youth Film School** is casting the role of **Agent Reid** for the upcoming teaser trailer **Project Shadow**.

**Please note:** This is a **volunteer, unpaid role** as part of a **student summer camp film project**. The trailer is being produced to give young filmmakers hands-on experience working on a professional-style production.

**Role**

**Agent Reid**
* Male or Female
* Playing age: **30–45**
* Calm, capable and authoritative.
* A skilled operative working for Project Shadow who secretly helps the children escape.
* A physically active role involving running and light choreographed action.

**Filming Date**

**Monday 28th July or Tuesday 29th July** *(one of these dates – exact day to be confirmed).*

**Time**

Approximately **2–3 hours of filming**, scheduled between **11:00 am and 3:00 pm**.

**Location**

**Gatley Village, Stockport** *(exact filming location will be provided upon casting).*

**About the Role**

Agent Reid is one of the organisation's operatives but begins to question their mission. In the trailer, Reid removes a child's tracking chip, helps the group escape the facility and stays behind to hold off the pursuing agents, allowing the children a chance to get away.

**Dialogue**

A small amount of dialogue, including the line:

"You're not getting out of here with those chips still inside you."

**Production**

**Project Shadow** is a cinematic action/thriller trailer produced by **Manchester Youth Film School** as part of its Summer Film Camp.

If you're interested, please send:
* A recent headshot
* Your availability for **28th and/or 29th July**

items.text:
Casting Feature Film:  **HANDS WHICH SHED INNOCENT BLOOD**:

Shooting in Los Angeles - Oct./Nov. 2026   Must work Local

NON-UNION - Non-Paid — Copy; Credit; Meals

Please email resume, with updated pic; height; age range; link to reel please.

Ridgley.james@gmail.com

If selected - 1st Self-tape with sides

2nd - Live auditions.

Thank you SOOOO MUCHHHHHH!!!

**EMILY ROTH** — Female, 22. A classically trained violinist with a voluptuous figure and homely face, arriving in LA from the Midwest. Naive, awkward, and endearingly flustered in social situations — prone to word-fumbling and self-deprecating humor. Beneath that vulnerability lives cold, calculating menace and a buried rage that can surface without warning. Must play comic vulnerability and genuine danger with equal conviction. Violin performance skills a plus.

**PETER** — Male, 27. Wiry, quirky-cute, and nerdish. A self-contained, tech-savvy loner with a warm romantic side and a quietly dangerous undercurrent. Socially awkward but deeply perceptive, with a fiercely protective streak. Must balance genuine sweetness with controlled menace.

**XAVIER** — Male, 30s. Soap-star handsome with a charming surface and a cold, cunning interior. Carries an easy sneer and turns intimidating quickly. Fundamentally a predator dressed as a landlord.

**CHLOE** — Female, 30s. Blonde, outwardly ditzy and warm, but shrewd and calculating underneath. Can shift from sisterly to threatening in an instant. Sharp comic timing essential.

**AIDEN** — Male, late 20s–30s. Jim Morrison looks — magnetic, loud, crude, and self-destructive. Sexually aggressive with rare flashes of genuine feeling. Rockstar energy required.

**JASMINE** — Female (trans). Warm, plainspoken, and grounded — the moral compass of the piece. Genuine dignity and emotional intelligence are essential to the role.

**DETECTIVE ROBBINS** — Male, late 40s–mid 50s. Heavyset and grizzled. A no-nonsense, straight-talking cop with a cigarette perpetually on his lip. Dogged and suspicious, with occasional flashes of empathy.

**GORDON ROTH** — Male, 50s. Nick Nolte type — sandy-haired, weathered, and beaten. Fiercely loving toward his daughter; cold and dangerous to everyone else.

**VINCE DEMATTO** — Male, 30s. Slick and well-dressed. Predatory under a smooth, confident charm. Featured role.

**STEVE HANSEN** — Male, mid-30s. Clean-cut and polished — more Harvard lawyer than creative. Charismatic and manipulative. Featured role.

**DETECTIVE HERNANDEZ** — Any gender, age open. Professional and steady. Small recurring supporting role.

items.text:
Behind the Scenes.

Es ist immer wieder spannend zu erleben, wie aus einem leeren Studio innerhalb weniger Stunden eine komplette Produktion entsteht. Licht, Styling, Make-up, Technik, Produktion, Fotografie – jedes Team arbeitet anders und entwickelt seinen ganz eigenen Rhythmus.

Vor Kurzem war das Team von Motor Presse Hamburg für ein Cover-Shooting der Women's Health bei uns im Onlight Studio zu Gast.

Vielen Dank an alle Beteiligten für die angenehme Zusammenarbeit. Ich freue mich schon auf das fertige Cover.

Das Studio wird regelmäßig für Foto- und Filmproduktionen, Musikvideos, Castings, Showreels, Werbeshootings und Content-Produktionen genutzt. Gleichzeitig bietet es Raum für Workshops, Business-Meetings und kreative Projekte.

Falls ihr für eure nächste Produktion eine passende Location im Rhein-Main-Gebiet sucht, findet ihr weitere Informationen unter:

www.onlight-studiorent.net

items.title: Poszukujem damskich

items.text:
Poszukujemy charyzmatycznych osobowości do nowego internetowego projektu o tematyce około motoryzacyjnej. Jeśli motoryzacja to Twoje środowisko i masz wyrazisty charakter — zgłoś się. Szukamy m.in. stereotypowego kierowcy BMW, spokojnego kierowcy, taksówkarza, byłego policjanta, byłego albo czynnego kierowcy zawodowego oraz innych osób z mocnymi poglądami na kulturę jazdy. Doświadczenie telewizyjne nie jest wymagane- liczy się autentyczność, osobowość i swoboda przed kamerą.

1. Zdjęcia w Warszawie.

2. Zdjęcia planowane są pod koniec sierpnia albo we wrześniu 2026. Dokładne daty do ustalenia.

3. Wynagrodzenie: 500 zł netto za 1 dzień zdjęciowy i prawa.

W razie zainteresowania, spełnienia wymagań, prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Link do profilu na Facebooku

8. Opisz kilka zdań o sobie oraz krótkie nagranie wideo (wizytówka).

9. Minimum trzy zdjęcia

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nowy projekt motoryzacyjny

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w nowym projekcie internetowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

items.text:
Are you a Samsung smartwatch and Samsung Health user who was gifted their watch by a family, friend, partner or loved one?

We’re looking for real Samsung users whose lives have been genuinely changed by the health features on their smartwatch or the Samsung Health app to appear in a global Samsung campaign.

✨ Filming: 1 day in mid-August

💰 Paid opportunity: Up to US$5,000

🏡 Plus a location fee if filming takes place in your home

🎥 No on-camera experience needed

If this sounds like you—or someone you know—we’d love to hear your story.

📩 Email apply@mcauleycasting.com with the subject line: Samsung Watch Gift

💰 Paid opportunity: Up to US$5,000

🏡 Plus a location fee if filming takes place in your home

🎥 No on-camera experience needed

If this sounds like you—or someone you know—we’d love to hear your story.

📩 Email apply@mcauleycasting.com with the subject line: Samsung Watch Gift

🎭 CASTING CALL — COSMIC HORROR SHORT 🎭

We're extremely excited to be casting our upcoming cosmic horror proof-of-concept short, RIFT — and we're searching for the right performers to bring this haunting story to life. 👁️

Logline: A grieving artist tries sketching her late wife's memory and instead opens herself to a trapped child's spirit, luring her toward a hole into darkness that may cost her soul.

We're seeking:

DAWN | Lead | 30s | Female

A grief-stricken artist and psychic sensitive.

MYRA | Lead (Supernatural) | 30s | Female

Dawn's deceased wife — calm, tender.

SERENA | Supporting (feature potential) | 50s | Female

Dawn's mentor and guide in psychic practice — elegant and composed.

THE CHILD | Supporting (Non-verbal) | 18+ (playing 10) | Female

A silent, uncanny spirit-child who lures Dawn. (Adult actor portraying a younger character.)

The details:

📍 Location: Burnaby, BC

📅 Shoot Dates: August 5 & 6

💰 Volunteer / deferred payment positions

🍽️ Hot meals, credit, and footage for your reel provided

We genuinely appreciate anyone interested in collaborating and helping us tell this story. 🖤

To audition: Email your headshot, reel, and resume (if available) to cosmeumproductions@gmail.com with your requested role in the subject line.

#CastingCall #IndieFilm #CosmicHorror #HorrorShort #Actors #VancouverActors #BurnabyBC #Filmmaking #IndieHorror #ProofOfConcept #NowCasting

Hey guys - just doing a shout out for an open mic cabaret night in Dalston next Wednesday 29th July  @ Ridley Road Market Bar. 

We are welcoming more performers to join us and perform an act - it could be a song, spoken word, comedy or an extract of something you are working on? Are you going to Edinburgh this year? 

This is unpaid as we are fundraising towards taking our show to Edinburgh but there is no pressure to donate! We want it be a gathering of creatives and a chance for us all to share our work - an opportunity to network and a platform for you to perform.  

We also have a specific casting call:

We are looking for an actor of Jamaican/Carribean heritage who feels comfortable with the Patwa (Patois) dialect to be able to read a couple of Benjamin Zephaniah's poems at our event. 

We are really excited to be welcoming Qian Zephaniah to our event, who has endorsed our show 'Dear Cathy'. One of his poems is part of our show and central themes that he speaks of. You would also be welcome to perform anything else that you would like of course! This would be a really special part of the evening and we hope you can join us! 

Please comment below and/or DM me if you are interested and would like to know more. 

Thanks so much, DC team. xX

items.text:
# 🎭 FINAL CASTING CALL – *A Place Not Mine* 🎭

Our cast is almost complete, and we're looking for **the final four performers** to join our original musical, **A Place Not Mine**, performing in **London this November**.

If you're looking to be part of a new original production with a passionate creative team, we'd love to hear from you.
## 🎭 Currently Casting
🎭 RIVEN

**Male | Playing Age: 18–25**
**Vocal Range: Baritone / Tenor**

Sensitive. Thoughtful. Haunted by the past.

Riven carries the emotional weight of the story. He's constantly torn between protecting the people he loves and facing his own fears, slowly discovering who he truly is.

**Character inspiration:** *Riven (Winx Club) × Connor Murphy (Dear Evan Hansen)*

**Please note:** This role includes a **staged kiss with another male actor** as part of the storyline.

🌙 SELENE

**Female | Playing Age: 18–25 / Soprano/Mezzo**

Funny. Honest. Fearlessly herself.

Selene speaks before she thinks, has absolutely no filter, and somehow always manages to make everyone laugh. Beneath her playful personality is someone incredibly loyal who would do anything for the people she loves.

**Character inspiration:** *Alex Russo × Barbie*

✨ ELARA

**Female | Playing Age: 18–25 / Any vocal range **

Confident. Sharp. Ambitious.

Elara isn't afraid to challenge people and has a naturally commanding presence. She may seem intimidating at first, but beneath her strong exterior is someone who loves fiercely and protects those closest to her.

**Character inspiration:** *Jade West (Victorious)*

🌿 ROWAN

**Male | Playing Age: 18–25**
**Vocal Range: Baritone / Tenor**

Charming. Quick-witted. The friend everyone needs.

Rowan is effortlessly likeable, always ready with a joke, but he's also the one who keeps everyone together when things begin to fall apart. Loyal, emotionally intelligent and impossible not to love.

## 🎤 Audition Process

1️⃣ Send us a DM expressing your interest.

2️⃣ If shortlisted, we'll arrange a short phone interview with the creative team.

3️⃣ Finally, send us a **30–60 second singing recording**.
**Disney songs are preferred, but not essential.**

## 📍 Rehearsals

London

• Sundays
• One additional weekday evening rehearsal (around cast availability)
## 🎭 Performances

**29th & 30th November 2026**

## 💙 Payment

This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.

We are applying for external arts funding and, **if successful, all available performer funding will be shared fairly across the cast.**

If one of these characters feels like you, we'd absolutely love to hear from you.

📩 **DM @a.place.not.mine to apply.**

Please feel free to **share this post** with anyone who may be interested. 💙

📍 **POZNAŃ i okolice**

🎬 **Poszukujemy bohaterki kampanii społecznej Fundacji Studio Figura**

Fundacja Studio Figura realizuje kampanię społeczną poświęconą **hejtowi, dyskryminacji i ocenianiu ludzi przez pryzmat wyglądu**.

Do udziału w spocie poszukujemy **dziewczyny lub młodej kobiety w wieku 16–25 lat**, która z własnego doświadczenia wie, czym jest ocenianie, wyśmiewanie lub hejt związany z wyglądem – w tym z chorobą otyłościową lub nadmierną masą ciała.

🟠 Szukamy osoby, która chciałaby swoim udziałem pomóc innym i pokazać, że za wyglądem każdego człowieka kryje się historia, której często nie znamy. Pragniemy stworzyć spot, który skłoni do refleksji i pokaże, że słowa mogą ranić, a empatia i zrozumienie mają ogromną moc.

📍 Poszukujemy osoby:

• w wieku **16–25 lat,**

• otwartej na udział w nagraniu,

• która utożsamia się z przesłaniem kampanii i chce wspólnie z nami przeciwdziałać hejtowi oraz dyskryminacji.

Jeśli czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie odezwij się do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej, lub pozostaw komentarz!

Razem możemy sprawić, że choć jedna osoba poczuje się mniej samotna i bardziej zrozumiana. 🧡

#KampaniaSpołeczna #niehejtuj #zwiększanieświadomości

topComments.text: There is an agency in London that requires models/ actors to pay hundreds of pounds for their “casting book” in which they put a picture of each performer in. Mostly the books are never seen by the performers as they don’t ship them out. They will take it out of the models booked job and have taken it from models earning less than the fee resulting in them actually spending money to travel and work with no payment and out of pocket. If they don’t agree to their terms then they say they will not have the model on their books. Their website states they have over 1000 performers on their books who will be made to pay this fee each year. Seriously exploiting people taking money from them when they haven’t even booked a job yet.
So were they a legit agency or not? It reads as if they exploited some people but still secured roles for others not that any form of exploitation is okay. I'm just confused on the nature of the scam

Dzień dobry! Casting do 21 sezonu serialu Gliniarze w Warszawie! 
11 ról, fajne stawki!!!! Można się zgłaszać do więcej niż jednej roli, jeśli się pasuje 🙂 Więcej informacji o tym, jak się zgłosić, gdzie i do kogo, na samym dole.

1. Hubecki (35) - szczupły, niepozorny mężczyzna, „szary obywatel”. Typ mózgowca i kujona. Po tragicznej śmierci córki postanawia ukarać Głowackiego, rozpoczyna grę na śmierć i życie. (2, 5, 7, 12, 15, 17a, 18) SPEC.

Terminy: 3 dni zdjęciowe 11.08, 12.08 i 15.08

Stawka: 1800zł na rękę 

2. Hubecka (36 - OFF) - żona Hubeckiego. Gra tylko z OFF. Będzie użyty tylko głos. (1) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 11.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę 

3. Brat Hubeckiego (41) - podobnie jak Hubecki - szczupły, drobny, niepozorny. Mimo wątpliwości wspiera brata w jego zemście, matacząc w śledztwie. (5 - off, 12 - off, 13 1 PLAN

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 11.08

Stawka: 500zł na rękę 

4. Mirowski (41) - zdradzony mąż i ojciec. Typ zapuszczonego tatusia - nadwaga, piwny bebzon, niezadbany wąs. Żona go zdradza z jego przyjacielem - Mirowski to ofiara losu. (21 - off, 22, 24, 25) SPEC.

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 12.08

Stawka: 600zł na rękę 

5. Żona (36) - żona Mirowskiego, która chce od życia więcej niż daje jej mąż. Atrakcyjna babka, wygadana, nie zamierza przyznawać się do romansu. (21, 23 2 PLAN

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 12.08

Stawka: 400zł na rękę 

6. Wujo Głowackiego (64) - poczciwy mieszkaniec prowincji. (6 - off, 15) 2 PLAN – PRAWO JAZDY

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 11.08

Stawka: 400zł na rękę 

7. Ciocia Głowackiego (62) - poczciwa mieszkanka prowincji. (15) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 11.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę

11. Nastolatka (17) - przypadkowa małolata w drodze do szkoły. (8) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 12.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę

12. Nastolatek 1 (16-17) - przypadkowy dzieciak w drodze do szkoły. (8) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 12.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę 

13. Nastolatek 2 (16-17) - przypadkowy dzieciak w drodze do szkoły. (8) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 12.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę 

14. Matka Hubeckiego (64) - emocjonalna i zapłakana kobieta. (2) EPIZOD

Terminy: 1 dzień zdjęciowy 11.08

Stawka: 300zł na rękę

—————————————————

Chętne osoby zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres e-mail:

natan.gliniarze@gmail.com

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci - można kilka, jeśli pasuje się do więcej niż jednej!!!!!

WAŻNE !!!

W treści maila proszę umieścić:
* linki do swoich materiałów video na YouTube
* aktualne zdjęcie
* wiek, wzrost, wagę
* informacje o dotychczasowym doświadczeniu 
* oraz nr telefonu do kontaktu

Jeżeli ktoś nie ma żadnych materiałów, to proszę o informację w mailu. Podeślę wybranym osobom scenkę do nagrania.

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu i noclegu.

# **CASTING CALL- *****Whatever Happens***

We are casting the lead role of *Amrita* in Whatever Happens, a character driven comedy-drama exploring friendship, family, and identity.

**SYNOPSIS**

When her mother pressures her into an unwanted arranged marriage, Amrita makes an impulsive decision with her best friend Jonah: they will marry each other. They soon discover that their plan forces them to confront deeper questions about love, family, identity, and the future they truly want.

**ROLE: AMRITA**

Female | 20s (Playable Age: 20–25) l South Asian l

Amrita is a creative and intelligent young woman caught between the life she has built in Canada and the future her mother wants for her. Funny and confident on the outside, she carries a deeper uncertainty about the dreams and parts of herself she has left behind.

We're looking for an actor who can bring emotional honesty, warmth, and complexity to the role!

Hindi or Punjabi fluency is strongly encouraged.

**SHOOT DETAILS**

**Location:** Vancouver, BC
**Shoot Dates:** Approximately 4 days in late August 2026
**Production Type:** Non-Union Independent Short Film
**Production Company:** Metamorphosis Films
**Compensation:** Volunteer production. Meals, craft services, and screen credit with footage provided.

**CONTENT INFORMATION**

This film explores friendship, family, and identity. Scenes include emotional conversations, simulated drinking, cultural/family themes, and a brief non-romantic kiss between characters for comedic effect. 

No nudity or sexual content is involved. We are committed to maintaining a respectful, collaborative, and professional set environment.

**TO APPLY**

Please send your headshot, demo reel (if available) and resume

to: 

whateverhappensshortfilm@gmail.com

Please also include your current location and availability for late August 2026.

Selected actors will receive self-tape sides and further audition instructions.

**Submission Deadline:** August 10, 2026

Self-tapes accepted until the deadline. Callbacks TBD.

Come join us, create something meaningful, and have fun along the way!

CASTING CALL – Child Models - Paid

I'm casting for a non-speaking product video featuring creative building toys
similar to LEGO-style construction sets. Non-union.

I'm looking for the following roles:
Role 1 - Female, Age 12–16, Caucasian
Role 2 - Male, Age 7–12, Caucasian

Ideal Candidates

- Outgoing, confident personalities who enjoy playing with toys
- Able to follow simple direction and stay engaged during filming
- Comfortable in front of the camera
- Previous modeling or acting experience is welcome, but not required

Project Details

- Non-speaking role
- Small-scale, two-person production team in a relaxed, low-stress environment
- Each child will likely be needed for 1–2 hours, though filming may extend up to 4
hours

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150
CAD per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks ideally) 
Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage
The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note
Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement
A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?
Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com:

- Child's name, age, and gender
- A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
- General availability over the summer
- Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting – (Age, Gender)
Example: Child Casting – 13, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

items.text:
**CASTING CALL: FILMING SATURDAY, AUGUST 8TH IN VANCOUVER**

Fourthframe Media is casting for our YouTube social experiment series: unscripted episodes where real people debate, deceive, and compete for a cash prize.

If you've seen Jubilee on YouTube, you know the vibe. We're building something like that right here in Vancouver.

**We're shooting 5 episodes and need people for:**
1. ⚫⚪ **Black vs Non-black:** Six Black contestants enter the room with one person secretly hiding. Through conversation, assumptions, and social instincts, the group has to figure out who is not who they appear to be.
2. ❤️ **Strangers Swipe On Each Other IRL:** Singles swipe face to face instead of through a screen, then find out whether the match still hits when the chemistry is real.
3. 📸 **6 Models vs 1 Fake:** Six real models and one convincing fake walk in. Can you fake a portfolio and a pose? The group has to clock who's pretending before the fake survives to the end.
4. 💰 **Split or Steal:** Every round forces a choice: share the outcome, or cut someone out to improve your own position. Trust is expensive.
5. 👀 **Siblings or Dating?**: Pairs walk in, and contestants have to read the vibe: family bond or romantic chemistry? The more convincing the pair, the messier the guess.

**Details:**
Location 📍: Vancouver, BC
Date 📅: Saturday, August 8th, 2026

🎬 This is volunteer-based. Winners take home a cash prize.
🙋 No acting experience needed; just be yourself and bring energy.

Apply here: [https://www.fourthframemedia.com/casting](https://www.fourthframemedia.com/casting)

Follow us on YouTube/Instagram/TikTok to see our latest episodes.

Instagram: [https://www.instagram.com/4thframemedia](https://www.instagram.com/4thframemedia)
YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@4thframemedia](https://www.youtube.com/@4thframemedia)
TikTok: [https://www.tiktok.com/@4thframemedia2](https://www.tiktok.com/@4thframemedia2)

Know someone who'd be perfect? Tag them or share this post.

#vancouver #socialexperiment #4thFrameMedia #JubileeStyle #RealVsFake #jubilee

**CASTING CALL: FILMING SATURDAY, AUGUST 8TH IN VANCOUVER**

Fourthframe Media is casting for our YouTube social experiment series: unscripted episodes where real people debate, deceive, and compete for a cash prize.

If you've seen Jubilee on YouTube, you know the vibe. We're building something like that right here in Vancouver.

**We're shooting 5 episodes and need people for:**
1. ⚫⚪ **Black vs Non-black:** Six Black contestants enter the room with one person secretly hiding. Through conversation, assumptions, and social instincts, the group has to figure out who is not who they appear to be.
2. ❤️ **Strangers Swipe On Each Other IRL:** Singles swipe face to face instead of through a screen, then find out whether the match still hits when the chemistry is real.
3. 📸 **6 Models vs 1 Fake:** Six real models and one convincing fake walk in. Can you fake a portfolio and a pose? The group has to clock who's pretending before the fake survives to the end.
4. 💰 **Split or Steal:** Every round forces a choice: share the outcome, or cut someone out to improve your own position. Trust is expensive.
5. 👀 **Siblings or Dating?**: Pairs walk in, and contestants have to read the vibe: family bond or romantic chemistry? The more convincing the pair, the messier the guess.

**Details:**
Location 📍: Vancouver, BC
Date 📅: Saturday, August 8th, 2026

🎬 This is volunteer-based. Winners take home a cash prize.
🙋 No acting experience needed; just be yourself and bring energy.

Apply here: [https://www.fourthframemedia.com/casting](https://www.fourthframemedia.com/casting)

Follow us on YouTube/Instagram/TikTok to see our latest episodes.

Instagram: [https://www.instagram.com/4thframemedia](https://www.instagram.com/4thframemedia)
YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@4thframemedia](https://www.youtube.com/@4thframemedia)
TikTok: [https://www.tiktok.com/@4thframemedia2](https://www.tiktok.com/@4thframemedia2)

Know someone who'd be perfect? Tag them or share this post.

# **PAID IMMERSIVE ACTORS WANTED | WEST SUSSEX | OCTOBER 2026**
# **Something strange is happening in West Sussex this October...**

Hi, I'm Davey, founder of **Ezra Immersive**.

After almost 20 years creating scare attractions, immersive theatre and live horror experiences for companies across the UK, I'm launching my own immersive theatre company, and I'm looking for performers to help bring our very first experience to life.

**RSVP** is a 75-minute immersive horror experience where audiences become guests at Tommy Crimble's 10th birthday party...

Again.

What starts as an awkward, painfully British birthday party slowly descends into something far more sinister.

Think **The League of Gentlemen** meets **The Texas Chain Saw Massacre**, with the escalating tension of **Resident Evil 7**, wrapped inside an interactive immersive theatre experience where comedy gradually gives way to horror.

We're casting five unforgettable characters:

• ***Tommy Crimble ***– the birthday boy who's definitely turning ten...
***• Pauline*** – the relentlessly cheerful mum determined to throw the perfect party.
***• Keith*** – the painfully polite father who believes there's a right way to do absolutely everything.
***• Nana ***– mostly asleep... until she isn't.
***• Kev*** – the painfully cringe party entertainer who's trying his best to keep the party going.

We're looking for performers who love creating characters, improvising with audiences and embracing both comedy and horror. Experience in immersive theatre, scare attractions or interactive performance is a bonus, but attitude, creativity and strong instincts are far more important.

**These are paid roles** based in **West Sussex**, with performances taking place across October 2026.

If this sounds like your kind of weird...

Head to my **Linktree** below and click **"Casting Call – RSVP"** for the full casting pack, character breakdowns, performance dates and application details. Or drop me an email at **hi@ezraimmersive.com**

See you at the party.

[https://linktr.ee/Daveyfoxezra](https://linktr.ee/Daveyfoxezra)

items.text:
# Wir suchen mehrere Gesichter für TikTok-Personal-Brands

Für bereits bestehende und marktreife Produkte suchen wir **mehrere sympathische, kommunikative und zuverlässige Personen**, die gemeinsam mit uns langfristig eigene TikTok-Personal-Brands aufbauen möchten.

# **Deine Aufgaben**
* Regelmässige Aufnahme von TikTok-Videos und weiterem Short-Form-Content
* Umsetzung von vorgegebenen Skripten, Briefings und Content-Ideen
* Authentische Präsentation und Bewerbung eines bestehenden Produktes
* Aufbau einer glaubwürdigen und langfristigen Personal Brand
* Zuverlässige und kontinuierliche Content-Produktion
* Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung der Inhalte

# Das solltest du mitbringen
* Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
* Du kannst Inhalte sympathisch, natürlich und überzeugend vermitteln
* Du arbeitest zuverlässig und hältst dich an Absprachen
* Du bist offen für Feedback und kannst Vorgaben professionell umsetzen
* Du hast Interesse an Social Media, Content-Produktion und Personal Branding
* Du möchtest langfristig mit einem festen Team zusammenarbeiten
* Eine bereits vorhandene Reichweite ist nicht erforderlich

# Was dich erwartet
* Klare Skripte, Briefings und Unterstützung durch unser Team
* Eine langfristig angelegte Zusammenarbeit
* Der Aufbau eines eigenen Social-Media-Auftritts
* Die Bewerbung eines bereits bestehenden und marktreifen Produktes
* Klare Prozesse und eine enge Zusammenarbeit bei der Content-Planung
* Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung mit prozentualer Beteiligung an den durch deinen Content generierten Leads Partenaire.

## Wir möchten **mehrere TikTok-Personal-Brands parallel aufbauen** und freuen uns deshalb über Bewerbungen von unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten.

## Bei Interesse sende uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Standort und ein kurzes Handyvideo, in dem du dich vorstellst. Vorhandene Social-Media-Profile oder Referenzen kannst du gerne ebenfalls mitschicken.

* Eine bereits vorhandene Reichweite ist nicht erforderlich

# Was dich erwartet
* Klare Skripte, Briefings und Unterstützung durch unser Team
* Eine langfristig angelegte Zusammenarbeit
* Der Aufbau eines eigenen Social-Media-Auftritts
* Die Bewerbung eines bereits bestehenden und marktreifen Produktes
* Klare Prozesse und eine enge Zusammenarbeit bei der Content-Planung
* Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung mit prozentualer Beteiligung an den durch deinen Content generierten Leads Partenaire.

## Wir möchten **mehrere TikTok-Personal-Brands parallel aufbauen** und freuen uns deshalb über Bewerbungen von unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten.

## Bei Interesse sende uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Standort und ein kurzes Handyvideo, in dem du dich vorstellst. Vorhandene Social-Media-Profile oder Referenzen kannst du gerne ebenfalls mitschicken.

Lights up, Lyons!

Future Hearts, Minds & Dreamers is thrilled to partner with Warrior Soul Gallery & Community Studio to bring high-quality theatre training to our community. Whether your child is just discovering the joy of storytelling, your teen is preparing for auditions, or you've always dreamed of stepping onto the stage yourself, there's a class for you.

All classes are taught by **Kytriena Payseno**, founder of Future Hearts, Minds & Dreamers, a professional actor, director, and acting coach with more than **40 years of experience** in theatre, film, and arts education. Kytriena has appeared in feature films, television, and commercial productions, directed theatre productions in both the United States and London, and has coached actors of all ages for school productions, community theatre, film, and professional auditions. With over three decades of teaching experience, she is passionate about creating a welcoming environment where every student can grow in confidence, creativity, and performance skills.

**Drama Llamas (Grades K–5)**
**Fridays | 3:00–4:00 PM**
Young performers will build confidence, creativity, teamwork, communication, and storytelling skills through imaginative play, theatre games, improvisation, movement, and beginning acting techniques. Perfect for students who love to create, pretend, and perform.

**L-Town Teen Players (Grades 6–12)**
**Mondays | 6:00–7:00 PM**
Designed for aspiring actors looking to strengthen their craft through audition techniques, script and character analysis, improvisation, stage movement, voice projection, cold reads, and ensemble performance. A great fit for students interested in school productions, community theatre, film, or preparing for college theatre programs.

**L-Town Adult Players (Ages 18+)**
**Sundays | 6:00–7:00 PM**
Whether you're trying acting for the first time or returning to the stage after years away, this supportive class focuses on acting techniques, scene study, monologues, improvisation, character development, and ensemble work while building confidence and stage presence in a fun, encouraging environment.

**Session Details**
• 12-week sessions
• Minimum enrollment: 8 participants
• Tuition: $227 per participant

Classes begin in late August, and space is limited!

Come learn from an experienced industry professional, connect with fellow performers, and discover the confidence, creativity, and joy that theatre can bring.

Register today at: [https://www.warriorsoulstudio.org/](https://www.warriorsoulstudio.org/)

We can't wait to see you on stage!

සුරංග ලක්මාල් සෙනෙවිරත්න මහතා ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ විශ්වවිද්‍යාල ක්ෂේත්‍රයේ රූපවාහිනී හා සිනමා නිෂ්පාදනය, අධ්‍යක්ෂණය සහ තිර රංගනය පිළිබඳ ප්‍රවීණ, ජනප්‍රිය බාහිර කථිකාචාර්යවරයෙකි.එතුමා University of Wales සහ Cardiff Metropolitan University (UK) වෙතින් පශ්චාත් උපාධි සුදුසුකම්, Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) සහ National Film Archive of India (NFAI) වෙතින් චිත්‍රපට රසවින්දනය පිළිබඳ ඩිප්ලෝමාව මෙන්ම කැලණිය හා ශ්‍රී ජයවර්ධනපුර විශ්වවිද්‍යාල වෙතින් සන්නිවේදන හා මාධ්‍ය අධ්‍යයනයට අදාළ උපාධි සහ පශ්චාත් උපාධි සුදුසුකම් ලබා ඇත.

මාධ්‍ය උපදේශක, රූපවාහිනී නිෂ්පාදක, ටෙලිනාට්‍ය අධ්‍යක්ෂ සහ රචකයෙකු ලෙස ද විශිෂ්ට වෘත්තීය අත්දැකීම් ඇති එතුමා, ශාස්ත්‍රීය දැනුම සහ කර්මාන්ත අත්දැකීම් ඒකාබද්ධ කරමින් සිසුන්ට ප්‍රායෝගික හා ගුණාත්මක ඉගෙනුම් අත්දැකීමක් ලබාදෙයි. සංකීර්ණ විෂය කරුණු සරලව පැහැදිලි කිරීමේ හැකියාව සහ පර්යේෂණ, වැඩමුළු හා ප්‍රායෝගික පුහුණුව හරහා මාධ්‍ය ක්ෂේත්‍රයට දක්ෂ වෘත්තිකයන් බිහිකිරීමට ලබාදෙන දායකත්වය හේතුවෙන් එතුමා සිසුන් අතර ඉහළ ගෞරවයක් හිමි කරගෙන සිටී.
 
🔰Mr. Suranga Lakmal Senevirathna is a distinguished and highly respected Visiting Lecturer in Sri Lanka, specializing in Television & Film Production, Directing, and Screen Acting.
He holds postgraduate qualifications from the University of Wales and Cardiff Metropolitan University (UK), a Diploma in Film Appreciation from the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) and the National Film Archive of India (NFAI), as well as undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications in Communication and Media Studies from the University of Kelaniya and the University of Sri Jayewardenepura.
With extensive experience as a Media Consultant, Television Producer, Teledrama Director, and Writer, he combines academic expertise with industry knowledge to deliver practical, high-quality learning experiences. Renowned for simplifying complex concepts, he continues to inspire students through teaching, research, workshops, and hands-on training, contributing significantly to the development of skilled media professionals.

LESS THAN 1 WEEK TO GO TILL LIGHTS, MUSIC & THRILLS

ALL PROFITS ARE GOING TO CANCER RESEARCH so if you want to learn about a whole new world and donate to an incredible cause - tickets are linked in bio or go to Durham fringe official website and search for the show

Venue - Palace Green Stretch Tent - Durham City Centre 
Time - 29th & 30th July at 5PM
Tickets - £3.50 - £5.00 pp
@durhamfringefest 

Lights, Music & Thrills is the fascinating, wonderful and sometimes weird world of one of the most endearing traditions of the life of the travelling showman. And the ups and downs he has to endure as his living depends on making people smile. Sometimes fun but sometimes a misunderstood and ugly way of life, looking from the outside in. You may well say the tears of a circus clown wearing himself thin for people’s enjoyment and indeed I should know! HERE TODAY AND IN NEXT WEEK TOMORROW...

Cosplay/er, a Horror Movie Born in Cosplay Culture

 

Cosplay/er is an independent horror feature filming in St. Petersburg, Florida in April 2027. The project is seeking actors (lead and supporting roles), extras, cosplayers, film crew, and volunteers. Portions of the film will be shot during St. Pete Comic Con 2027, creating an authentic convention atmosphere unlike anything that can be recreated on a soundstage.

 

The movie's crush-worthy characters and application forms can be found at the website: [https://cosplayslasher.com/](https://cosplayslasher.com/)

 

While not required for consideration, there are two in-person casting calls at fan conventions: Sunshine City Scare on August 15-16, and Holiday St. Pete on Nov. 21-22 - both at the Hilton St. Petersburg Bayfront. Registration is preferred. There are no fees associated with the casting calls or any other movie info sessions, but an event ticket is required for entry (tickets are affordable- $25 per).

NOW CASTING – FLIGHT OF THE DRAGONS
A New Fantasy Series from Vintage Productions

Filming Location: Boston, Massachusetts (and surrounding areas)

Vintage Productions is seeking talented actors for lead, supporting, and ensemble roles in Flight of the Dragons, an epic fantasy series about destiny, friendship, war, and discovering where you truly belong.

On her 18th birthday, Stormy is gifted a reckless dragon unlike any other. Instead of following tradition, the dragon carries her into a mysterious new world filled with allies, danger, romance, and ancient secrets. As war threatens the home she left behind, Stormy must choose between the life she's always known and the future she's only begun to imagine.

Roles Available

Lead Roles

Stormy – Female, 18–25. Brave, compassionate, determined.

Lyra – Female, 18–30. Wise healer with quiet strength.

Wren – Female, 18–30. Clever rogue with a guarded heart.

Elara – Female, 20–35. Fearless warrior and mentor.

Kaiya – Female, 18–30. Princess determined to change her kingdom.

Sorenna – Female, 20–35. Powerful mystic with knowledge of both worlds.

Supporting Roles

Zara – Female, 20–35. Skilled hunter and survivor.

Isla – Female, 18–30. Dreamer filled with hope.

Maeve – Female, 20–35. Sorceress hiding a dangerous past.

Brielle – Female, 20–35. Loyal protector.

Arian – Male, 20–35. Charming rogue with hidden depth.

Rhys – Male, 20–35. Noble warrior torn by duty.

Asher – Male, 18–30. Quiet mystic gifted with rare magic.

Ensemble Roles Seeking performers ages 16–30 for villagers, warriors, scholars, mercenaries, soldiers, court members, and other fantasy world characters.

Compensation

Paid opportunity

Travel and lodging provided

Meals on set

IMDb credit

Filming in and around Boston, MA

items.text:
**PRODUCER, part time, in person, Santa Monica**

Men optimize their sleep, their training, their money. Then they go home to someone they can't reach and call it fine. I'm a clinical psychologist. I train men to center pleasure. My message lives at [@theintimacydoc](https://instagram.com/theintimacydoc), and it's becoming a book.

Right now I'm the talent, the producer, the strategist, and the person answering DMs at midnight. Three of those have to go.

**The work**
* Decide what we're shooting each week, where, and why
* Send me scripts. Tell me which of mine to cut
* Find the podcasts worth my time, pitch them, run that calendar
* Read what the numbers are actually saying and change next week because of it
* Keep the video editor moving
* Hold the message together so it stops fragmenting across platforms

I lead the creative. You help me make it, and you say so when it isn't good.

**You**
* You've produced something start to finish. Video, podcast, live event, campaign, brand work. Size doesn't matter. Ownership does
* You think holistically. The podcast, the shoot, the book, and the schedule are one thing to you, not four
* You have taste and you'll defend it in the room
* Nothing drops with you
* This work means something to you. If men's loneliness reads as a niche, don't apply

**What this is not**
* Social media management
* Remote
* A job where you wait to be told what to do

**Terms**

10 to 15 hours a week, in person in Santa Monica. Paid. 

**To apply**

Email [connect@theintimacydoc.com](mailto:connect@theintimacydoc.com) with the subject line PRODUCER. Send:
1. Something you produced end to end, and what you'd do differently now
2. Three podcasts you'd put me on, and the angle for each
3. Your availability
4. Your resume

Miss any of the four and I won't read it.

🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Mag. Barbara Fahringer-Postl über Steuerrecht und finanzielle Stabilität. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 173. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 11.08.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten. 

©Congerdesign 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/7MvGL7qkB  

#KunstUndWirtschaft #KulturUndWirtschaft #Kulturmanagement #Kreativwirtschaft

Hi all,

We’re still looking for as many extras as possible for a short Horror film we’re shooting this Thursday at The Hope Street Theatre. 

If you’re available and would like to be a part of the film, please contact amulliganfilm@gmail.com or message me directly. Please share to anyone else who you think may be interested. We can also provide catering on set for those involved 🙂

Looking forward to hearing from some of you,
Andrew

**KRAKÓW - ŚPIEWAJĄCY AKTORZY POSZUKIWANI - ZLECENIE DOBRZE PŁATNE - NOWA DATA **

**Wszystkie osoby, które już wysłały mi swoje zgłoszenie i są dostępne w nowym terminie - uprzejmie proszę o podbicie mi maila i potwierdzenie dostępności!**

Do spotu reklamowego dla producenta słodyczy poszukuję:

**- 2 kobiety młodsze (35-45 lat) // do 2 scen**

aktorki/ grający naturszczycy z doświadczeniem, naturalne, ciepła energia, nie idealnie piękne / modelowe, spontaniczne, możliwe podobieństwo fizyczne (siostry / kuzynki)

- **mężczyzna (45-55 lat) // do 1 sceny**

aktor/ grający naturszczyk z doświadczeniem, naturalny i autentyczny, nie idealnie piękny / modelowy. Figura - lekko „zasiedziany home office”

- **dzieci:** **dziewczynka (około 7 lat) i chłopiec (około 10 lat) //** **do 1 sceny **

grające - z doświadczeniem przed kamerą, naturalne, autentyczne, radosne i żywiołowe, potrafiące amatorsko tańczyć, możliwe podobieństwo fizyczne (rodzeństwo / kuzyni)

- **3 kobiety starsze (około 50 lat) //** **do 1 sceny **

aktorki/ grający naturszczycy z doświadczeniem, naturalne i autentyczne, bardzo pozytywne, nieskrępowane, żywiołowe, wyraźnie różniące się typem figury i urody, nie idealnie piękne / modelowe

- **babcia (około 70 lat) //** **do 1 sceny **

aktorki/ grający naturszczycy z doświadczeniem, miejska fajna babcia, z luzem i naturalnością, otwarta i z auto dystansem 

**Wymagana umiejętność u wszystkich – śpiew aktorski / dobry śpiew amatorski i doświadczenie przed kamerą!**

Role epizodyczne nie mówione ale śpiewane, na dalszym etapie castingu wybrane osoby poproszę o nagranie wskazanej piosenki. 

**Prawa na 5 lat bez ograniczeń terytorialnych, pola eksploatacji TV, internet, kino, radio, outdoor, POS. **

**Zdjęcia 10 sierpnia 2026 w Krakowie (okolicach)**. 

Nie zapewniamy noclegu, ewentualnie zwrot kosztów dojazdu (paliwa, bilety na pociąg).

Zgłoszenia wraz ze zdjęciami, wideo wizytówką i danymi do kontaktu proszę przesyłać na adres: ***castingotwarty@gmail.com ***w tytule proszę o wpisanie roli, do której się zgłaszacie. 

Nie przyjmuję zaproszeń do znajomych, nie wchodzę w 

konwersacje pod postem i na priv - skontaktuję się z wybranymi osobami.

Dziękuję :)

Witam serdecznie, poszukuje młodego człowieka reżyserii, który kojarzy film Nietykalni z powodu, że moja osoba tak funkcjonuje. Mam propozycję filmu, który ma szansę na orły i inne nagrody festiwalowe. Jest tylko jeden haczyk, zależy mi na tym żeby prace zacząć od zaraz.
Zaznaczam, że ja narazie nie mam nic ..... jedynie co to story board.

 Współpraca dosłownie od dzisiaj i naprawdę proszę osoby zdecydowane, a nie takie, które przez 2 dni nie potrafią przeczytać story boardu.

Na ten film czeka cale środowisko OzN.

 Preferowany student WSF.

Możemy to zrobić na jakiś dyplom czy coś takiego.

Podkreślę, że nie poszukuje tylko  rezysera. W znaczeniu osoby, która  reżyseruje gotowy produkt tylko prace trzeba zacząć od zera.

🎬 POSZUKUJEMY STATYSTÓW DO FILMU KOSTIUMOWEGO! Ekranizacja  znanej powiesci

Warszawa i okolice

Do filmu kostiumowego, którego akcja rozgrywa się w XIX wieku oraz na początku XX wieku, poszukujemy statystów.
📅 Terminy zdjęć:
11.08
13.08
Część osób zostanie wybrana do udziału w obu dniach zdjęciowych (kontynuacja), a część tylko na jeden z podanych terminów.
👔 Przymiarki kostiumów:
6.08
7.08
10.08

Poszukujemy osób do ról:
Mieszczanie
Typ pracowniczy
Żydzi

💰 Stawki:
120 zł – udział w jednym dniu zdjęciowym
180 zł – udział w dwóch dniach zdjęciowych (kontynuacja)
50 zł – przymiarka kostiumu
Płatność: gotówką.

Wymagania: Poszukujemy wyłącznie osób o naturalnym wyglądzie:
bez zabiegów medycyny estetycznej,
bez makijażu permanentnego brwi,
bez hybryd i pomalowanych paznokci,
bez tatuaży w widocznych miejscach,
bez włosów strzyżonych maszynką oraz bez współczesnych fryzur.

📧 Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na adres: agencjasceneria.magda@gmail.com

Tytuł wiadomości: BB 113

W treści zgłoszenia prosimy podać:
aktualne zdjęcia twarzy oraz sylwetki (bez makijażu), Panowie - zdjecie boku I tyl fryzury. Panie zdjecie w rozpuszczonych wlosach
imię i nazwisko,
wiek,
informację o posiadanych tatuażach,
numer telefonu.

ZZapraszay

Za każdą wyjątkową restauracją stoi wyjątkowy człowiek…
Szukamy restauratorów z całej Polski do nowego programu TV! 📺🍽️

Bo najlepsze jedzenie to dopiero początek…

Chcemy poznać ludzi, którzy stworzyli niesamowite miejsca z prawdziwą duszą. Restauracje, w których liczy się nie tylko to, co trafia na talerz, ale też historia, emocje, atmosfera i ludzie, którzy ją tworzą. ❤️

Szukamy wyjątkowych miejsc:

✨ restauracji z charakterem i niepowtarzalnym klimatem

✨ rodzinnych biznesów tworzonych z sercem

✨ kulinarnych perełek ukrytych w całej Polsce

✨ lokali, które mają swoją historię 

✨ właścicieli, dla których gotowanie i goszczenie ludzi to prawdziwa pasja

Czy goście przychodzą do Was nie tylko dla jedzenia, ale też dla atmosfery, którą stworzyliście?

Czy za Waszym miejscem stoi historia, którą warto opowiedzieć całej Polsce?

📩 Napisz do nas zgloszenia@rochstar.tv - w załączniku dodaj krótką wideowizytowkę i opis Twojej restauracji :)

# 🎭 CASTING CALL – LEAD ROLE AVAILABLE
## **RIVEN** | *A Place Not Mine – Musical*

Our cast is almost complete, and we're looking for **one final performer** to join us as **Riven** in our original musical, performing in **London this November**.
🎭 About Riven

Male | **Playing Age:** 18–25

🎤 **Vocal Range:** Baritone / Tenor

📏 **Height:** Ideally **175cm (5'9") or above**, but performers of all heights are encouraged to apply.

Sensitive. Thoughtful. Haunted by the past.

Riven carries the emotional heart of the story. Struggling with grief, guilt and the fear of never being enough, he slowly learns to trust others and discover who he truly is.

This is a challenging role requiring emotional honesty, vulnerability and strong acting ability.

**Character Inspiration:**
✨ *Riven (Winx Club) × Connor Murphy (Dear Evan Hansen)*

**Please note:** This role includes a **staged kiss with another male actor** as part of a romantic storyline.

## 🎬 Audition Process

📩 **Step 1:** DM us on Instagram to express your interest.

📞 **Step 2:** If shortlisted, we'll arrange a short phone interview with the creative team.

🎵 **Step 3:** Send us a **30–60 second singing recording** *(Disney songs preferred, but not essential).*

## 📍 Rehearsals

London

• Sundays
• One additional weekday evening rehearsal
## 🎭 Performances

**29th & 30th November 2026**

## 💙 Payment

This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.

We are applying for external arts funding and, **if successful, performer funding will be shared fairly across the cast.**

If you're looking for a role that will challenge you emotionally and give you the opportunity to help create a brand-new original musical from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

📩 **DM @a.place.not.mine to apply.**

**Please feel free to share this post with anyone who might be the perfect Riven.** 💙

Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję kobiet do następujących ról:

1. Marta (32) – Bardzo ładna, inteligentna, pielęgniarka.
Data: 12.08
Stawka: 600 zł netto

2. Sprzątaczka (37) – Fajna, ciepła kobieta,
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Koleżanka Teresy (42) – Mądra życiowo, bardzo spokojna, cicha.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4. Teresa (43) – Stłamszona przez męża, ewidentnie z syndromem sztokholmskim: mimo przemocy fizycznej i psychicznej, ciągle do niego wraca. Miła, pomocna, szczera. Szczupła, dość ładna, ale widać, że nie dba o wygląd.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 600 zł netto

5. Sąsiadka (56) – Dużo widzi, często wzywała policję. Nie jest wścibska, ale nie lubi patrzeć na cierpienie innych, dlatego zawsze reaguje.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Do you love analog horror, ’80s horror films, and internet horror? Then this project is for you.

Pig Man is an indie found footage horror short following a brutal killer stalking the streets of London.

Logline:
One man’s childhood hunger was never satisfied. His family… the pigs on their farm… were never enough. Now he craves more, and the streets of London have become his perfect hunting ground.

I’m currently in pre-production and looking to cast two female actors for the project, with plans to shoot within the next month.

Casting Call

I’m looking for two female actors to play club goers enjoying a night out in London before their evening takes a terrifying turn when they encounter Pig Man.

Previous acting experience is preferred but not essential — the most important thing is a passion for horror, storytelling, and collaborative indie filmmaking.

The project draws inspiration from analog horror, ’80s horror films, and internet horror, with a focus on creating an unsettling found footage experience. The roles will involve helping create a realistic portrayal of a normal night out before the story shifts into something much darker.

This is a true indie production with a small, collaborative team focused on creating an authentic found footage horror short.

This is an unpaid project ￼

What Cast Will Receive:

* Food and snacks provided during filming
* One provided meal during the shoot
* Footage for personal portfolios/showreels
* Full screen credits for their work on the project

The shoot will take place over one day and will ideally be around five hours long, either in the afternoon or evening.

If you’re interested in getting involved, please send me a message on Facebook Messenger with a little information about yourself, your acting experience, and any relevant work or showreels.

Pitch deck included in this post.

Looking forward to working with fellow creatives and creating something unique in the world of indie horror.

items.text:
Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role:

Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

I can offer £15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over the City of Milton Keynes.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.3 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline starting August.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. — at Milton Keynes.

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline starting August.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. — at Milton Keynes.

Cześć! Poszukujemy aktorki do roli **Kasi** w naszym nadchodzącym filmie **"Mazurian Summer Story"**. Pełnometrażowy mikrobudżet fabularny.

**OFERTA PŁATNA**

**TERMIN ZDJĘĆ:** 11.08 – 16.09.2026 (Kasia ma dni zdjęciowe w wybrane dni w tym przedziale czasowym).

Casting składa się z dwóch etapów. Na początek prosimy o podesłanie wizytówek i próbek w formie **Self-Tape**. Jeśli Twoje nagrania nam się spodobają, odezwiemy się i zaprosimy Cię na casting na żywo!

**KOGO SZUKAMY (OPIS POSTACI):**
* **Kasia (wiek z wyglądu ok. 19 lat):** Introwertyczka, która z determinacją dąży do celu (np. zdobycia chłopaka, który jej się podoba) i – jak każdy w jej wieku – zmaga się z trudnościami okresu wchodzenia w dorosłość. Jest zainteresowana głównym bohaterem filmu i stara się zwrócić na siebie jego uwagę, aktywnie o nią zabiegając (mimo swojej introwertycznej natury).
* Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (część roli jest anglojęzyczna).

**INSTRUKCJA NAGRANIA SELF-TAPE**

Prosimy o nagranie i przesłanie **4 krótkich filmików**. Możesz je zmontować w jeden plik lub wysłać jako cztery osobne wideo.
* **Film 1 (po angielsku 🇬🇧):** Opowiedz o swojej relacji z dziadkami, jeśli znasz ich osobiście. Jeśli nie, opisz kogoś znacznie starszego od siebie, kogo znasz osobiście i lubisz. Wyjaśnij, co najbardziej Ci się w tej osobie podoba.
* **Film 2 (po polsku 🇵🇱):** Opowiedz o swoich ogólnych relacjach z filmami i o Twoich doświadczeniach związanych z chodzeniem do kina.
* **Film 3 (po polsku 🇵🇱):** Wyjaśnij, jakie to uczucie widzieć siebie na ekranie po zakończeniu kręcenia zdjęć.
* **Film 4 (Scena dialogowa 🇬🇧/🇵🇱):** Poproś kogoś z otoczenia (podrzucacza), aby przeczytał zza kamery kwestie Ewy. Odegraj rolę Kasi według poniższego scenariusza.

**SCENARIUSZ DO FILMU 4**

**Kontekst sceny:** Kasia chce dyskretnie podkreślić różnicę wieku i przypomnieć o tym Ewie. 
**Zadanie:** Kasia podchodzi do Ewy.

**KASIA** *(po angielsku)* 
Have you finished the game? Can I join? 
*(Skończyliście grę? Mogę dołączyć?)*

**EWA ***(po angielsku)* 
Yeah, sure. 
*(Tak, jasne.)*

*(Ewa robi miejsce dla Kasi, żeby mogła usiąść. Kasia siada.)*

**KASIA** *(po polsku)* 
Dziękuję... pani.

**EWA** *(po polsku)* 
Możesz mi mówić "Ewa".

JAK APLIKOWAĆ?
1. Nagrania (najlepiej w formie niepublicznego linku do YouTube, Vimeo lub linku do pobrania z WeTransfer/Google Drive) prześlij na adresy e-mail: 
- **zgloszenie44@gmail.com** oraz 
- **production@tobineko.pl**
2. W tytule maila wpisz: **CASTING KASIA – [Twoje Imię i Nazwisko]**
3. Do maila dołącz swoje aktualne portfolio / zdjęcia oraz numer telefonu.
4. Na zgłoszenia czekamy do: **30.07.2026**

Pamiętaj o dobrym świetle i wyraźnym dźwięku. Nagrywaj w poziomie!

Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi kandydatkami, aby umówić się na casting na żywo. Powodzenia i do zobaczenia!

Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję kobiet do następujących ról:

1. Marta (32) – Bardzo ładna, inteligentna, pielęgniarka.
Data: 12.08
Stawka: 600 zł netto

2. Sprzątaczka (37) – Fajna, ciepła kobieta,
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Koleżanka Teresy (42) – Mądra życiowo, bardzo spokojna, cicha.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4. Teresa (43) – Stłamszona przez męża, ewidentnie z syndromem sztokholmskim: mimo przemocy fizycznej i psychicznej, ciągle do niego wraca. Miła, pomocna, szczera. Szczupła, dość ładna, ale widać, że nie dba o wygląd.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 600 zł netto

5. Sąsiadka (56) – Dużo widzi, często wzywała policję. Nie jest wścibska, ale nie lubi patrzeć na cierpienie innych, dlatego zawsze reaguje.
Data: 13.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

1. Kamil (24) – agresywny socjopata i patologiczny kłamca z przeszłością w poprawczaku, mocno zadłużony. Silny, na dopalaczach, bezwzględne spojrzenie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY 
Daty: 10.08 i 11.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

2. Adrian (27) – Interesuje się strzelectwem, jest instruktorem na strzelnicy. Zostaje postrzelony przez kolegę, gdy próbuje obezwładnić go podczas włamania.
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Dominik (28) – prowadzi spółkę zajmującą się kompleksowym montażem nowoczesnych instalacji elektrycznych, alarmów i monitoringu. Zostaje pobity. Średniej budowy ciała, nie jest silny fizycznie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4. Pracownik 2 (28) – pracownik budowlany
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

5. Sebastian (30) – prowadzi komis, karany w przeszłości za kradzieże. Skupuje kradziony sprzęt.
Data: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

6. Pracownik 1 (37) – pracownik budowlany 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

7. Konrad (39) – brat Artura. Nieporadny, z bardzo niską samooceną, wiecznie gnębiony przez brata i niedoceniany przez rodziców. Przez całe życie gromadził w sobie żal i gniew. Wysoki, szczupły, dłuższe włosy.
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Daty: 12.08 i 14.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

8. Biznesmen (45) – elegancko ubrany mężczyzna, zostaje napadnięty na ulicy. 
Daty: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9. Właściciel (48) – przedsiębiorca budowlany. Zawiadamia policję o zaginięciu pracowników i pomaga w identyfikacji. 
Daty: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

**Recherche comédienne - Tournage clip (Rhône - 69)**

**Rémunération prévue.**

 

Dans le cadre du tournage d'un clip, nous recherchons une comédienne pour incarner une directrice des ressources humaines.

**Le rôle**

Une DRH qui incarne une certaine autorité, très sûre d'elle, et dont le jeu passe beaucoup par le visage, les regards, le maintien, les mimiques…

 

**Profil**

• Femme, apparence 50 à 65 ans

• Visage expressif, à l'aise avec les micro-expressions

• À l'aise avec le registre comique comme avec le jeu sérieux

• Expérience de plateau appréciée, non obligatoire

 

**Infos pratiques**

• Date : vendredi 21 août 2026

• Lieu : Lyon

• Durée : une journée de tournage

• Rémunération prévue

 

**Pour candidater**

Envoyez-nous un message avec une photo récente et une courte présentation ou votre CV. Un lien vers un portfolio ou des extraits de vos travaux est un plus, sans obligation.

→ 23.23label@fmail.com ou en message privé.

Le détail du projet et de la séquence sera transmis aux personnes retenues.

**CASTING CALL – PAID + EXPENSES COVERED | GERMANY | SEPTEMBER 2026**

We're casting for **These Little Moments**, a heartfelt coming-of-age drama set in 2002 about four childhood friends reuniting for one final summer road trip before tragedy changes everything.

We're looking for actors **playing ages 20–27** for four lead roles:

**JAMES (20–27)**
The geeky guy who overthinks every move he makes. He has had a secret crush on Emma for ages but never quite had the guts to ask her out, always telling himself he could wait for the right moment. Over the course of the trip, he learns that the right moment doesn't always come, and that if he truly cares about something, he has to act.

**RUBY (20–27)**
The caring leader and enthusiastic glue of the group. She has always loved living in their small town and never questioned it, but lately, watching her friends leave one by one, she has started to doubt the choices she made. Underneath the big energy is someone quietly afraid of being the one left behind.

**EMMA (20–27)**
An optimistic girl who hides her fears behind a smile. She left their hometown young to study fashion, and she still wavers between chasing her dreams and the pull of the life she left behind. Now she has a once-in-a-lifetime chance in front of her, but her own dark thoughts hold her back and leave her yearning for somewhere that feels safe.

**ELIO (20–27)**
The lovable stoner who doesn't have big dreams and is perfectly fine with that. He loves music and looks forward to a simple life running a small CD shop. His laid-back demeanour makes people think he doesn't care, but beneath it, he is devoted to his friends, filming every moment of the holiday because he can't imagine life without them.

 **Shooting:** Germany (Berlin/Brandenburg)
 **Dates:** 8–17 September 2026
 **Language:** English

If you're interested, please send your **CV/showreel**, a **short introduction**, which **character you'd like to play**, and **why the project intrigued you** to:

**crasherscollective@gmail.com**

Feel free to share this post with anyone who might be a great fit—we can't wait to hear from you!

++ 🔥Wenn der Metal die Hölle entfesselt... 🔥++

Ab August 2027 entsteht auf dem Gelände des Rock the Farm Langerringen  Festivals eine Horrorcomedy, die das Metal-Genre auf den Kopf stellen könnte.

Was passiert, wenn ein friedliches Heavy-Metal-Festival plötzlich zum Epizentrum einer Dämoneninvasion wird?

Genau diese Frage soll ab August 2027 auf dem legendären ROCK THE FARM-Gelände in Langerringen beantwortet werden – dort, wo jedes Jahr echte Metalheads gemeinsam feiern, soll schon bald das Grauen Einzug halten. 

Doch keine Sorge: Zwischen blutigen Monstern, höllischen Kreaturen und dem drohenden Weltuntergang bleibt reichlich Platz für rabenschwarzen Humor, absurde Situationen und jede Menge Heavy Metal.

Stellt euch vor:

Ein Festival. Hunderte Metalfans. Gitarren. Schlagzeug. Bier. Moshpits. Die lautesten Bands des Abends...

...und plötzlich öffnet sich mitten auf dem Gelände ein Tor zur Hölle.

Während Dämonen das Festival übernehmen und Chaos ausbricht, müssen ausgerechnet Musiker, Crew-Mitglieder und Besucher zusammenhalten. Denn wer glaubt, dass nur Weihwasser gegen das Böse hilft, kennt die Macht einer voll aufgedrehten Metalmeute noch nicht...

Die Macher sprechen von einer Liebeserklärung an die Metal-Szene. Wer Festivals kennt, wird unzählige Anspielungen entdecken. Wer Horror liebt, darf sich auf dämonische Kreaturen, übernatürliche Eskalationen und spektakuläre Effekte freuen. 

Und wer schwarzen Humor mag, könnte hier seinen neuen Kultfilm finden.

Eines steht jedoch schon jetzt fest:

Ab August 2027 wird auf dem ROCK THE FARM-Gelände nicht nur Metal gespielt - dort wird die Hölle ihre Tore öffnen, die Verstärker werden beben und die Nacht wird blutrot.

Vielleicht beginnt genau hier der lauteste, verrückteste und durchgeknallteste Horrorfilm, den die deutsche Metal-Szene jemals gesehen hat.

Und mit im aktuellen Team sind Menschen, die unter andrem bei folgenden Projekten vor und/oder hinter der Kamera standen: 

- LEVIZIA 
- ⁠START YOUNG 
- ⁠THE LAST TRAIN 
- ⁠DARK DAYZ 
- ⁠VHS: UNDERGROUND 1+2
- ⁠PUPPENMACHER
- ⁠WRONGFUL DEATH 
- ⁠ONG BAK 
- ⁠STREETFIGHTER: CHUN LI  
- ⁠BELLY OF THE BEAST 
- ⁠BIG GAME - DIE JAGD BEGINNT 
- ⁠DAS MEDDAILLON (mit Jackie Chan)
- ⁠MATRIX 4 (!!!) 

Und wenn du Teil davon sein willst: 

Wir suchen noch: 

👉 Metal-Statisten 

👉 Leute mit Erfahrung im Bereich Special Effects

👉 Leute, die uns hinter der Kamera aushelfen 

👉Co-Producer (inkl. rechtsgültigem Vertrag), die Teil des Projekts sein wollen!

🔥Stay tuned. Denn das ist erst der Anfang… 🔥

@Follower 
Erik Markus Schuetz Jean Rises elina.mj Christian Matthesius Sprachrohr Eisregen #Inanis KveldulF Spanky Ham 

#heavymetal #comedy #movie #Splatter #Horror #fun #specialeffects #festival
